boardIntro: Keep track of what's clean and what's in the wash. Items marked “To wash” or “In laundry” are left out of outfit suggestions until they're back.
emptyMessage: Add items to your wardrobe to track washing and ironing here.
laundryDoneMessage_one: Where does the {{count}} item from the laundry go now?
laundryDoneMessage_other: Where do the {{count}} items from the laundry go now?
labelNote: Copy these from the care label sewn into the garment. ClosetWise never guesses care instructions — it only keeps what you enter.
temperatureInvalid: Enter a whole number between 0 and 95.
unspecifiedHint: Leave a choice unselected if the label doesn't say.
notesPlaceholder: e.g. Wash inside out, with similar colors
